basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old animation enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, often drawing inspiration from the cartoons and animated films I loved as a kid. I'm single, but have a tight-knit group of friends who share my love for retro gaming and animated movies. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually after 10 PM, when I unwind with some music and a good animated film. I dislike overly serious content and prefer light-hearted discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a BA in Graphic Design and have spent countless hours self-teaching through online courses and tutorials. My passion for animation started early, fueled by Saturday morning cartoons and extended into my professional life, where I often incorporate whimsical and vibrant elements into my designs.
